model.name: PtyBridge
model.description: Owner-gated websocket PTY bridge: xterm.js <-> ws <-> node-pty attaching a GROUPED tmux session (no-disrupt to other viewers) bound to the selected pane (R31.4). Handshake gated by an owner-bound single-use ~30s ticket (browsers can't set ws headers; app auth is post-connect). READ-ONLY default (tmux attach -r + server drops key frames); interactive only on owner-gated Take-Control (respawn read-write, same grouped session). Audit quad ATTACH/CONTROL_TAKEN/DETACH/DENY. Design-ahead; intended impl src/ts/server/PtyBridge.ts. See design-server-manager.md.
